The person behind the projects

HELLO,
I’m TORRES.

✳

A student exploring software, design, and the space between them.

Close to everyday life

It starts with
something I notice.

A game night that could run more smoothly. A school question that takes too long to answer. An idea that needs somewhere to live.

These are the kinds of starting points behind my projects. I’m interested in how a digital tool can fit the way people already think, ask, and spend time together.

Through building

Make, question,
and try again.

My work brings together product decisions, interface experiments, and implementation. Werewolf, Fold, and Handbooker each give me a different way to explore that connection.

On Werewolf, I worked with AI as a collaborator in building and debugging, while shaping the purpose, requirements, design choices, and next steps around the dorm community.

The next chapter

A welcome
worth working on.

I’m planning a website for incoming dormitory students. It’s a chance to explore a different part of community life: the moment before a new place starts to feel familiar.
